build_translation_task: build a multilingual translation task using TranslationMultiSimpleEpochTask with specified language pairs and dictionaries
setup_task_multilingual: setup a multilingual translation task by calling TranslationMultiSimpleEpochTask.setup_task with argparse args
load_dataset_split: load a dataset split for training or validation using TranslationMultiSimpleEpochTask.load_dataset with epoch and shard support
create_batch_sampler: create a custom batch sampler function using TranslationMultiSimpleEpochTask.create_batch_sampler_func for multilingual data batching
run_inference_step: run inference on a sample using TranslationMultiSimpleEpochTask.inference_step with prefix tokens and language tokens
